items.summary: Update the Notes page category filter tabs to include four new categories: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", displayed alongside the existing tabs (All, General, Publishers, Territories, Service, Other) and styled identically to the existing category tabs.

Update the Add Note modal category dropdown to include four new selectable category options: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", without changing, removing, or renaming any existing category options.

Ensure the Edit Note modal category dropdown (when editing an existing note) includes the same four new category options: "LDC", "Food Service", "Personal", and "Family", and that existing notes with these categories can be viewed and saved without category validation/type errors.
